traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and named requirements for 001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP are satisfied. The plugin is implemented in TypeScript with a standard ESLint plugin structure, dynamic rule registry, flat-config presets for ESLint v9, robust error handling for rule loading failures, and comprehensive Jest-based test coverage (including CLI and flat-config integration). User-facing setup and configuration instructions are documented in README.md and user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md, and internal development guidance is provided in docs/eslint-plugin-development-guide.md and docs/custom-rules-development-guide.md. All referenced tests for this story pass under the current test run, confirming the implementation is complete and stable.
